text: ООО «Зевс», the 97.5% owner of the Olimpbet operator ООО «БК «Олимп», was founded by two private individuals, Andrey Petukhov and Darina Denisova, holding 50% each, per EGRUL registry data republished by RusProfile.
short: ООО «Зевс» is owned 50/50 by individuals Andrey Petukhov and Darina Denisova.

source.name: RusProfile: ООО "Зевс" company profile (EGRUL data, archived by the Wayback Machine)
source.quote: Петухов Андрей Николаевич и Денисова Дарина Борисовна, каждый из которых владеет 50% долей с вкладом по 210 млн рублей
source.note: Russian: Petukhov Andrey Nikolayevich and Denisova Darina Borisovna, each owning a 50% share with a contribution of 210 million rubles. The page's EGRUL founders section lists the same two individuals as the company's founders. Archived capture of 2025-07-05; the live site blocks datacenter requests.
